blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Megawide Construction Corp. has completed the structural frameworks of two housing towers in Dasmariñas, Cavite, advancing its socialized housing projects under the government’s Expanded Pambansang Pabahay Para sa Pilipino (4PH) Program. Its subsidiary, Megawide Dreamrise Residences Inc. (MDRI), held the simultaneous topping-off of Towers C and D at Jab Residences on Oct. 1. READ: Megawide primed for P28.3-B revenues from 4PH venture On Thursday, the Edgar Saavedra-led construction and engineering firm said the project reached this stage seven months after its concrete pouring ceremony in February.
